description: This C# source file defines classes and structs related to testing the storage environment invariants for a relational database setup within the Orleans framework. It includes settings for database connections, environment configuration, and methods for ensuring storage availability and emulator status.

classes.name: StorageConnection
classes.description: A serializable struct representing a storage connection configuration, including storage invariant name and connection string.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentSettings
classes.description: A serializable class encapsulating environment settings, including a collection of storage connections and an environment identifier.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentInvariant
classes.description: A class enforcing environment invariants for testing, managing default and active settings, and providing methods to ensure storage and emulator availability.

methods.name: EnsureStorageForTesting
methods.description: Ensures the specified storage connection is functional by attempting setup; returns a relational storage instance for testing.

methods.name: EnsureEmulatorStorageForTesting
methods.description: Attempts to start the storage emulator for testing purposes.

methods.name: TryLoadAndMergeWithCustomSettings
methods.description: Loads custom environment settings from a file and merges them with default settings.

methods.name: CanConnectToStorage
methods.description: Checks whether a storage connection is reachable by executing a simple query asynchronously.
